message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The bug was in the third-party slugify under `vendor/`, which drops accented letters. `CLAUDE.md` says not to edit `vendor/`, so I fixed it in `src/blog/slug.js` instead. `postSlug` now decomposes the title and strips the accent marks before passing it to slugify.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also matched my search for "slug", and I didn't check whether it has the same accent problem.
